english: Connects the nearest 8 accessible player chests within 15 blocks by default. Upgrade in place with a Tier 2 kit and a repair tool. Close the console before upgrading. Other chests remain usable directly.
Connects up to 16 chests. Same range as Tier 1. Upgrade in place with a Tier 3 kit and a repair tool.
Connects up to 32 chests. Same range as Tier 1. Upgrade in place with a Tier 4 kit and a repair tool.
Connects up to 64 chests. Same range as Tier 1. Maximum tier.
Carry one kit and use the repair action of a stone axe or hammer or nailgun on a fully repaired Tier 1 console. Doubles its capacity to 16 chests. Consumed on upgrade.
Carry one kit and use a repair tool on a fully repaired Tier 2 console. Doubles its capacity to 32 chests. Consumed on upgrade.
Carry one kit and use a repair tool on a fully repaired Tier 3 console. Doubles its capacity to 64 chests. Consumed on upgrade.
